products.name: DSPy
products.note: Declarative prompt-and-weight optimization; compile pipelines against a metric instead of hand-tuning prompts; Stanford NLP research lineage

profile_text.body:
Stanford NLP is a university research lab, not a commercial entity, and the website captured by the pipeline resolves to GitHub rather than a dedicated Stanford NLP web presence, so the site content on record does not describe the lab directly.

The lab is tracked in connection with DSPy, a framework for declarative prompt and weight optimization that allows developers to compile language model pipelines against a defined metric rather than tuning prompts by hand. DSPy is hosted on GitHub under the stanfordnlp organization and is categorized as a coding and developer tool with a Stanford NLP research lineage.

No litigation, SEC filings, MCP servers, or patent records are held for this organization.
